import "join"

disk = from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "storage_shard_disk_size")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["path"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "bucket", "id", "_value"])

files = from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "storage_tsm_files_total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["path"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "bucket", "id", "_value"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)

join.inner(
    left: disk,
    right: files,
    on: (l, r) => (l["_time"] == r["_time"]) and (l["bucket"] == r["bucket"]) and (l["id"] == r["id"]),
    as: (l, r) => ({l with files: r._value}),
)
|> group(columns: ["_time", "bucket"])
|> sum()
|> group(columns: ["bucket"])

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "storage_bucket_measurement_num")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["bucket"] =~ /${buckets:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "storage_bucket_series_num")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["bucket"] =~ /${buckets:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_api_requests_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.path == "/api/v2/query")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "counter")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: max, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "method", "response_code", "user_agent"])

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "boltdb_reads_total" or r._measurement == "boltdb_writes_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "counter")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: max, createEmpty: true)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "derivative")

bytes_used = from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "go_memstats_alloc_bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gauge")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  
total_bytes = from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "go_memstats_sys_bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gauge")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

join(tables: {key1: bytes_used, key2: total_bytes}, on: ["_time", "_field"], method: "inner")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _value: (float(v: r._value_key1) / float(v: r._value_key2)) * 100.0,
    _field: "Memory Usage Percent"
  }))
  |> yield(name: "percentage")

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "go_memstats_alloc_bytes_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "counter")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: max, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "derivative")

from(bucket: "influx_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "go_memstats_mallocs_total" or r._measurement == "go_memstats_frees_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "counter")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "derivative")

  |> max()
